analyst_view.overall: Lille are 35th with 1 point from 4 games after losing 1-0 at home to Lyon, so this is close to their last chance of the play-offs; Tiago Santos, Igamane and Nianzou are out (all counted), while Ethan Mbappe returns from a ban and Ayase Ueda may start after a foot injury. Bayern (13th, 8 points) are badly hit: Kane (ankle, out for months) and Olise (foot) are out and both are now on the numbers' list, with Neuer, Davies, Gnabry and Saibari also missing. Kompany said on Tuesday that Musiala and Luis Diaz are not options to start (Sport1), so UEFA and Sports Mole expect a young attack built around 18-year-old Lennart Karl with Bischof, Binder or Brown. Italian referee Marco Guida (3.6 cards a game) is named and already counted.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.4 goals and now take Kane (-15%) and Olise (-14%) off Bayern, which was most of my earlier 12% cut, so I don't repeat it. What they still don't see is that Musiala and Luis Diaz will only come off the bench, leaving Karl, Bischof and Binder to start; that is a mild extra cut, about 5%, to around 2.3.

corners.text: The numbers expect 9.7 corners, split almost evenly. A makeshift Bayern front line may be less dangerous but should still have most of the ball, while Lille must push for a win at home; these pull in opposite directions, so I stay at 9.7.

cards.text: The numbers expect 3 cards, already cut about 12% for referee Marco Guida's low card count and 12% for Bayern's quiet recent record. Lille's must-win mood could add a booking late on, but that is a hunch, so I stay at 3.

shots.text: The numbers say 25 shots, nearly 15 from Bayern, and their missing-player adjustment only touches goals, not shots. Kane and Olise are Bayern's two most frequent shooters and Musiala and Diaz start on the bench, so a young line led by Lennart Karl should create less; Lille needing a win stops me going further, so about 23 (25 x 0.93).

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.1 shots on target, and the absences of Kane and Olise only move their goals, not their shots on target. Without their best finishers and with Musiala and Diaz only on the bench, Bayern should test the keeper less, so I go down to about 8.4.
